rationale: Conflicted, low-edge tape: the 15m long-breakout flag (level 383.06, vol_ratio 2.78) sits on near-zero real volume with many 0.0-volume bars - a thin-weekend squeeze that lifted 5m RSI to 88.8 and 15m RSI 73 AGAINST a decisive 4h downtrend (RSI 32). Composite short p_win is only 0.376 and this account's shorts bleed, so fading the stretched 5m invites illiquid melt-up chop; the fake breakout is not a long trigger. US cash closed until Mon and Q2 earnings Wed Jul 22 - no honest R:R at mid-range (support 377.78 / resistance 410.51) justifies carrying risk. Flat. Reconsider on a loss of 377.78 on real volume (4h downtrend resumes -> short).
